title: On Reporting the loss to the whole village
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：report　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 report 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the guide ① reported the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② reports the loss to the whole village at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ report the loss to the whole village at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reported the loss to the whole village before — a line in the guidebook for July 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reporting the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ report for duty before the eighth at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Report for duty before the eighth at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ reports for duty before the eighth without a word of thanks every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reported the loss to the whole village again when nobody else would.

⑩ To report the loss to the whole village, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody reports the loss to the whole village at once again and somebody must report the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 报告（一般过去式 reported the loss to the whole village：1968 年向导头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 报告（一般现在 reports the loss to the whole village：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 报告（不定式 to report the loss to the whole village：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 报告（过去完成时 had reported the loss to the whole village：1962 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 报告（动名词 reporting the loss to the whole village 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 报到（report for duty before the eighth：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去报到八号前报到当差）
G. v. 报到（report for duty before the eighth：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 报告（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 reports for duty before the eighth，而母亲又一次 reported the loss to the whole village）

answers.why: report 意为“报告”，1968 年向导不图一句谢报告向全村报告那次损失，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reported。
report 意为“报告”，自那以后向导二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reports。
report 意为“报告”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯报告向全村报告那次损失”，此处为不定式 to report the loss to the whole village。
report 意为“报告”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人报告过，故用过去完成时 had reported。
report 意为“报告”，向导说“报告向全村报告那次损失这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reporting the loss to the whole village 作主语。
report 意为“报到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去报到八号前报到当差”，should ever 之后用原形 report for duty before the eighth。
report 意为“报到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻报到八号前报到当差（report for duty before the eighth at once），以后再也不要提起。
report 意为“报告”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例报到八号前报到当差，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reports。
report 意为“报告”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢报告向全村报告那次损失，用一般过去式 reported 叙述。
report 意为“报告”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要报告向全村报告那次损失，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，向导不图一句谢报告向全村报告那次损失；山谷里每一个旅人都说这是头一回。（reported the loss to the whole village）
多年以后，向导仍二话不说地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（reports the loss to the whole village）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯报告向全村报告那次损失这件事本身。（to report the loss to the whole village）
早在 1962 年就有人报告向全村报告那次损失，七月那天旅行手册上的一行字就是证据。（had reported the loss to the whole village）
向导说过，不图一句谢报告向全村报告那次损失这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reporting the loss to the whole village 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻报到八号前报到当差，以后再也不要提起。（report for duty before the eighth，祈使句）
answers: In 1968 the guide reported the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the guide still reports the loss to the whole village at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to report the loss to the whole village at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had reported the loss to the whole village long before 1975, and the line in the guidebook for July proves it.
Reporting the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 report 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the guide reported the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide reports the loss to the whole village at once whenever the valley asks.
Reporting the loss to the whole village without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever report for duty before the eighth at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley reports for duty before the eighth without a word of thanks every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reported the loss to the whole village again, and the valley remembered that half.
